image_analysis.description: Brief description of the page: layout (columns, marginalia, tables), typeface or hand, language(s), position of page numbers, catchwords, signature marks and footnotes, and any damage or legibility problems.

transcription.description:
- Task: Return a diplomatic, markdown-formatted, verbatim transcription of the page.
- Scope: Transcribe all visible text and structural elements (running heads, headings, body text, marginalia, footnotes, catchwords, signature marks, tables, captions) unless the context or instructions exclude them.
- Diplomatic fidelity: Keep spelling, capitalization, punctuation, abbreviations, contractions, ligature letters, long s (ſ), u/v and i/j usage, superscript letters and special characters exactly as printed or written. Do not modernize, normalize, expand abbreviations or correct apparent errors.
- Line breaks: Preserve every line break of the original. Keep line-end hyphens and split words exactly as shown.
- Markdown structure: Use `#`/`##` for headings, `*italic*` and `**bold**` where the typography marks them, and markdown tables for tabular matter.
- Page numbers: Write printed page or folio numbers from running heads or footers like `<page_number>9</page_number>`.
- Footnotes: Write footnote references as `[^1]` in the text and the notes as `[^1]: Note text`.
- Images and ornaments: Mark illustrations, initials, ornaments and diagrams as `![Image: short description]`.
- Uncertainty: Wrap doubtful readings in `<unclear>...</unclear>` with your best reading inside. Mark illegible or lost text with `<gap/>`. Never guess silently.
- Multi-column text: Transcribe column by column, keeping the line breaks within each column.
- Cross-page continuity: Words and sentences continuing from the previous page or onto the next page are transcribed exactly as they appear on this page.
- Empty pages: If the page carries no transcribable text, return null and set no_transcribable_text to true.
- No fabrication: Transcribe only what is visible. Do not complete, summarize or translate text.

no_transcribable_text.description: True if the page contains no transcribable text (blank page, pure illustration); otherwise false.

transcription_not_possible.description: True if and only if transcription is entirely impossible (e.g. the page is illegible throughout); otherwise false.
